title: The recursive function
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun strip(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> o filterObject ((x) -> x != null and x != "") mapObject ((x, k) -> { (k): strip(x) })
  case a is Array -> a map strip($)
  else -> v
}
---
strip({ a: null, b: "", c: [null, { d: "", e: 1 }] })
